import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_FILE = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Create directories if they don't exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
print(f"Loading {TRAIN_PATH}...", flush=True)
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
print(f"Loading {TEST_PATH}...", flush=True)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
print(f"Loading {SAMPLE_SUB_PATH}...", flush=True)
df_sample = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

# Define label columns matching submission order
LABEL_COLUMNS = [
    "toxic",
    "severe_toxic", 
    "obscene",
    "threat",
    "insult",
    "identity_hate",
]

# Prepare Features and Targets
comment_texts_train = df_train["comment_text"].fillna("").values.tolist()
features_train = comment_texts_train
labels_train = df_train[LABEL_COLUMNS].astype(float)

comment_texts_test = df_test["comment_text"].fillna("").values.tolist()

# Create TF-IDF Vectorizer with reduced features for faster training
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 1), 
    sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(comment_texts_train).toarray()
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(comment_texts_test).toarray()
n_features = X_train_vec.shape[1]
print(f"Using {n_features} features")

# Split Training Data - create holdout validation set from TRAIN ONLY
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_vec, labels_train.values, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Dictionary to store models and their metrics
results = {}

# Train one model per label
models = []
for i, target_name in enumerate(LABEL_COLUMNS):
    print(f"\nTraining for {target_name}...", end="", flush=True)

    # Get Y for this specific label
    y_val_target = y_val_split[:, i]

    # LightGBM Dataset constructors
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(
        X_train_split,
        feature_name=[str(k) for k in range(n_features)],
        group=None,
        label=y_train_split[:, i],
    )
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val_split,
        feature_name=[str(k) for k in range(n_features)],
        group=None,
        label=y_val_split[:, i],
    )

    # Optimized parameters for faster training
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "force_col_wise": True,
        "learning_rate": 0.07,
        "num_leaves": 15,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
    }

    # Early stopping callback to avoid timeout
    best_iteration = None
    def early_stop_callback(epoch):
        nonlocal best_iteration
        if epoch > 0:
            preds = model.predict(X_val_split)
            current_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_target, preds)
            print(f"  AUC: {current_auc:.6f}", flush=True)
    
    train_result = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=1500,  # Will be stopped early
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        callbacks=[early_stop_callback],
    )
    best_iteration = train_result.best_iteration
    
    model = train_result.booster_
    
    # Compute Validation AUC for this label
    preds_val = model.predict(X_val_split)
    auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val_target, preds_val)
    results[target_name] = auc_val
    print(f"{target_name} Val AUC: {auc_val:.6f}")

    models.append(model)

# Calculate Mean Column-Wise ROC AUC (validity estimate)
mean_auc = np.mean(list(results.values()))
print(f"\nMean Column-Wise ROC AUC (Validation Estimate): {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Generate Test Predictions using stored models
preds_array = np.zeros((len(LABEL_COLUMNS), len(df_test)))
for i, target_name in enumerate(LABEL_COLUMNS):
    if i < len(models):
        preds = models[i].predict(X_test_vec)
        preds_array[i] = preds

# Construct Submission DataFrame - match sample submission template
sub_df = df_sample.copy()
for i, target_name in enumerate(LABEL_COLUMNS):
    col_name = LABEL_COLUMNS[i]
    sub_df[col_name] = preds_array[i]

# Save to correct location
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")
print(f"\nFinal Evaluation Metric: {mean_auc:.6f}")
